reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch rule out an angelic reading of Genesis 6's "sons of God" precisely because Christ says angels cannot marry, so no angel ever took a human wife.

sides.snippet: God's sons saw that men's daughters were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives of all that they chose.
sides.verseText: that God's sons saw that men's daughters were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives of all that they chose.

sides.snippet: they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
sides.verseText: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
